create_glm4v_model: create a GLM-4.1V multimodal model with vision encoder and language model for conditional generation
run_vision_forward_pass: run the vision model forward pass on pixel values with grid dimensions to produce image embeddings
get_image_features: get image features by passing multimodal data items through the visual encoder to produce embeddings
get_video_features: get video features by processing temporal frame sequences through the visual encoder with 3D rope embeddings
load_model_weights: load HuggingFace checkpoint weights into the GLM-4.1V model with support for qkv and gate_up weight sharding
